body.text: Her Own Voice Goals: Teach independence & identity. Play early Janet. Then “Nasty.” Let your son hear the difference between being controlled vs taking control.

body.label: Key points
items: Growing up in the Jackson family’s shadow
First two albums → label-driven, didn’t reflect her voice
Janet deciding to RECLAIM her artistry
Teaming with Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis (legendary production duo)
